approach: Static recompilation of the single-player game's x86 code (CoDSP.exe and its game, cgame and ui DLLs, 2003) to C with a project-specific recompiler, Windows / OpenGL / Miles Sound System reimplemented as host code (OpenGL ES through vitaGL on PS Vita)
notes: Runs on macOS and on PS Vita (Vita3K) through static recompilation; no emulator runs the game's CPU code. The engine executable and the three game DLLs it loads at run time are recompiled together, the DLLs rebased into one 32-bit guest space; the renderer's OpenGL calls go straight to the host driver, and Miles Sound System 6.5 is reimplemented on SDL.
